landing.probTitle: Apps teach lessons. LinguaAI builds a loop.
landing.probDesc: Assess → Personalize → Learn → Practice → Feedback → Review → Improve. Your mistakes resurface as tomorrow's plan — nothing you learn gets lost.
landing.prob1d: A 20-question placement test plus your Smart Path read your level, weak skills and due words — no wandering through content you already know.
landing.prob2d: Every word you save links into reading passages, listening tracks, spelling drills and writing checks. One vocabulary powers five skills.
landing.prob3d: XP, daily streaks and badges reward the return — not the binge. Five focused minutes beat an hour once a month.
landing.showDesc: One question per screen. Big answer cards. Sticky bottom actions. Bottom sheets, never tiny modals. Designed for a 360 px phone first.
landing.sh1d: 20 questions · one per screen · level reveal with celebration.
landing.sh2d: 100-word level bank · 3D flip · swipe right = known, left = review.
landing.sh3d: 15 topics, 3 per level · lesson + 5-question quiz · instant grading.
landing.sh4d: 10 passages, 2 per level · tap any word for a peek definition · comprehension quiz.
landing.sh5d: 10 tracks: dialogues, monologues, podcasts · per-line play · forgiving typing check.
landing.sh6d: 5 mixed questions a day · streak flame · XP ring against your daily goal.
landing.mTitle: From signup to streak in four steps.
landing.mDesc: A concrete path, not a content dump. You always know what to do next and why.
landing.m1d: 20 questions across vocabulary, grammar, reading and listening. You get a CEFR level (A1–C1) with a per-skill breakdown — delivered like a result worth celebrating.
landing.m2d: The engine reads your level, weak skills, mistakes, due words and recent history, then builds a 1–5 step plan under 45 minutes. Same input → same plan, every step explained.
landing.m3d: Flashcards with swipe physics, one-question-per-screen quizzes, tap-to-peek reading, per-line listening and dictation with forgiving grading. Every tap gives instant feedback and XP.
landing.m4d: Due words resurface right on time, the Daily Challenge guards your streak, and badges mark first steps, perfect days and warm-ups. Retake placement anytime to certify growth.
landing.dd1d: Twenty questions, zero fluff. Each screen asks one thing with big tappable answers, a live progress bar and a calm tone — then reveals your level like a result worth celebrating.
landing.dd1b3: Guided vs free path choice after result
landing.dd2t: Words that refuse to be forgotten
landing.dd2d: Save any word in one tap. Spaced repetition serves due words first; swipe right for known (+3 XP), left to review again (+1 XP). Mastery meters show exactly where each word stands.
landing.dd3t: Train your ears, then your fingers
landing.dd3d: Real-feeling tracks with device audio, per-line replay and highlighted lines. Dictation mode checks your typing with forgiving grading — exact matches earn +5 XP.
landing.dd4t: A coach that reads your data
landing.dd4d: Smart Path fuses weak-skill detection, mistake history, review schedule and streak state into today's plan — and explains every step. The AI Teacher answers open questions in your language.
landing.curDesc: Two passages, three grammar topics and twelve core words per level — plus listening tracks matched to your stage.
landing.curA1d: 12 core words · be/have/can, articles, plurals · slow dialogues
landing.curA2d: 12 more words · past tenses, comparatives · short stories
landing.curB1d: 12 more words · perfect tenses, conditionals · podcasts
landing.curB2d: 12 more words · passive, reported speech · debates
landing.curC1d: 12 more words · nuance, idioms · full podcasts
landing.gamDesc: Animated XP ring against your daily goal. A streak flame that begs to stay lit. Badges for first steps, perfect days and warm-ups.
landing.cmpDesc: Phrasebooks don't adapt. Tutors cost a fortune. LinguaAI sits in the sweet spot.
landing.proofTitle: Five minutes a day actually sticks.
landing.q1t: The bottom-tab app feels native. I do the challenge on the bus — 34-day streak and counting.
landing.q2t: Placement nailed my level. Smart Path stopped repeating what I already knew.
landing.q3t: Tap-to-peek words in reading plus dictation grading is my favorite loop. The XP ring keeps me honest.
landing.q4t: Flashcards with swipes finally made me review daily. 400 words feel easy now.
landing.q5t: The AI Teacher explains grammar in Russian while examples stay English. Exactly what I needed.
landing.q6t: I retook placement after two months: A2 → B1. The per-skill breakdown showed where I grew.
landing.fq1q: How long until I feel progress?
landing.fq1a: Most learners finish placement in ~6 minutes and get a Smart Path for today. The Daily Challenge takes 5 minutes — streaks and XP make it stick. Retake placement monthly to certify growth.
landing.fq2a: Yes. Placement finds your level, then content steps down when accuracy drops below 40%. Tap any highlighted word for a definition in a bottom sheet — you never get stuck.
landing.fq3q: Do I need to pay or install anything?
landing.fq3a: No. It runs in the browser, installs as a PWA on your home screen, and visited pages work offline. Sign in only to sync progress across devices.
landing.fq4q: How does the AI Teacher work?
landing.fq4a: Open-ended chat with compact, low-cost prompts. Explanations come in your interface language (English, Russian or Kazakh) while examples stay in English. Quizzes are deterministic and need no AI at all.
landing.fq5q: How does Smart Path choose my plan?
landing.fq5a: Deterministically: due-word review first, then the Daily Challenge, then your weakest skill, then concrete mistakes, then fresh at-level content. Every step shows its reason — same input always gives the same plan.
landing.fq6q: What happens to my streak when I travel?
landing.fq6a: Your timezone is yours: streaks, goals and challenges follow your local day, with a ±1-day tolerance for travel. Set it once in Profile — midnight never steals a streak again.
landing.fq7q: Can I use it in Russian or Kazakh?
landing.fq7a: Fully. The whole interface — buttons, lesson structure, AI explanations — switches instantly between English, Russian and Kazakh. Your English level setting stays independent.
landing.fq8a: Your words, attempts and XP live in your own rows protected by database policies. AI features use compact prompts with only relevant context — never your whole history.
landing.finDesc: Join LinguaAI, take the placement, get today's Smart Path. Free to start.
